ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The main body in the figure is an organic skeleton containing R and R¹ substituents, the central carbon is connected to two unspecified substituents R and R¹, and forms a double bond with a nitrogen; this nitrogen is then connected to another nitrogen bearing hydrogen, and the whole can be read as R-C(=N-NH2)-R¹. The figure also shows an upper HO⁻, and a lower H-O-H water molecule; curved arrows indicate the mechanistic process, which the question requires to ignore. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, R and R¹ are represented by wildcard atom *, connected to the central carbon, giving *C(*)=NN. The lower water molecule is represented by O; the upper negatively charged hydroxyl group is represented by [OH-]. Three components not connected to each other are connected with periods, therefore the SMILES is *C(*)=NN.O.[OH-].

method.method_draft: First describe the image, then transcribe it: identify the organic skeleton as R-C(=N-NH2)-R1, ignoring the mechanistic arrows and treating R and R1 as unspecified groups. Convert R and R1 to wildcard atoms attached to the central carbon, giving `*C(*)=NN`. Separately encode the bottom water molecule as `O` and the top negatively charged hydroxide as `[OH-]`. Join the disconnected components with periods to obtain `*C(*)=NN.O.[OH-]`.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中主体是一个含 R 和 R¹ 取代基的有机骨架，中心碳与两个未指定取代基 R、R¹相连，并与一个氮形成双键；该氮再与另一个带氢的氮相连，整体可读作 R-C(=N-NH2)-R¹。图中还显示一个上方的 HO⁻，以及下方的 H-O-H 水分子；弯箭头表示机理过程，题目要求忽略。推理：忽略箭头后，R 和 R¹ 用通配原子 * 表示，连到中心碳上，得到 *C(*)=NN。下方水分子用 O 表示；上方带负电的羟基用 [OH-] 表示。三个彼此不连通的组分用句点连接，因此 SMILES 为 *C(*)=NN.O.[OH-]。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct visual-to-SMILES transcription; this is the natural single route for the problem and uses no reaction-arrow interpretation.
planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the drawing as a static structure and ignore all curved arrows. Read three disconnected components: an organic fragment with a carbon bearing two generic substituents R and R1 and double-bonded to N, followed by a single-bonded N with hydrogens; a neutral water molecule H-O-H; and a separate hydroxide HO with a negative charge.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that arrows in the image should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: generic R/R1 substituents can be represented by wildcard atoms `*`; omit most explicit hydrogens on ordinary N/O unless needed for charge; represent disconnected species with periods; neutral water may be written as `O`; hydroxide is `[OH-]`; the C=N-N connectivity is written as `C=NN` with wildcard branches on carbon.
